evidence: Adjacent to the `same` call above and deliberately separated from it: CodeRabbit asserts that an e2e TEST is missing, while this panel finding reports a defect in the test HELPER (`applyGlobalBootstrap` does not mirror the bodyParser verify hook). Writing the missing test would surface the helper defect but not fix it, and correcting the helper does not add the test. Two edits, two defects.

panel.summary: Integration bootstrap helper does not install the rawBody `verify` hook added in main.ts, so any e2e exercise of the webhook would 401
panel.evidence: packages/backend/test/helpers/integration-helpers.ts:75-84 `applyGlobalBootstrap` applies only the ValidationPipe; it does not mirror the `bodyParser.json({ verify })` capture added at packages/backend/src/main.ts:47-56. Test apps built with it (e.g. packages/backend/test/authenticated-http.e2e-spec.ts:74) therefore never populate `req.rawBody`, and `YorkieSignatureGuard` would reject any signed webhook request as "Missing webhook signature". Fix belongs in the helper (or by moving the bootstrap into a shared function used by both main.ts and the helper).
